{{Quote|Eidolon Security's got a stockpile of munitions bound for the Republic Army. Crates are at their manufacturing facility in the Corellian Sector. If that facility were to blow up, the Eidolon would owe the Republic billions of credits--which I'm guessing he ain't got just lying around.|[[Gele'ren]]|<ref name="TOR:EB" />}}
'''Eidolon Armaments''' was a munitions factory located in the [[Corellian Sector (Nar Shaddaa)/Legends|Corellian Sector]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] that was part of the [[Eidolon Security]], owned by a former assassin [[Eidolon (assassin)|Eidolon]]. During the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]]<ref name="TOR:EB" /> in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]] assaulted the Eidolon Armaments and destroyed munitions ready to be shipped to the Republic in order to draw Eidolon, who was a target of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]], out of hiding.<ref name="TOR:EB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eidolon Armaments appear as an area on Nar Shaddaa in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR:EB" />
